known_before_run: the author has seen the OPT-01 Stage A secants and their linear/diagonal predictions, the LOWDIM-04A/04B results and the pre-CFD gate table of this inventory; NO prediction of Stage B outcomes is registered (the linear predictions are reported by the analyzer for hindcast only); this is not blind validation.
prohibitions: no second iteration, curvature model, basis expansion, reinitialization or further step beyond this ladder
no automatic resubmission or repair after a terminal/integrity failure
an ACCEPT is a record-level status of this trial, not an optimizer or flag qualification and not a go-ahead

rules.accept: strictly more than 3e-5 N downforce gain and a computed drag change <= 0 on BOTH grids, plus every pre-CFD gate (LOWDIM-04B rule, evaluate_candidate unchanged)
rules.gate_rejected_steps: a positive step failing a pre-CFD gate is recorded gate-REJECTED (not dropped, not shrunk), still runs in CFD for the record, is ineligible, and can never be accepted or selected
rules.incomplete: any integrity failure, one grid incomplete, a non-finite run: no analysis is written
rules.parent_gate: fresh parent CSVs must be byte-identical to the retained OPT-01 Stage A parent runs (flow_24, flow_32) before any other state runs
rules.pre_cfd_gates: under contract v1.1 gate_scope (F1): proposal states (parent, positive steps) the full GEOM-02 profile v2 bundle incl. crossing-slope near_zero_gradient_band, P22-v2 N_phi <= 8272 with a positive count-equal margin and the retained LOWDIM gates; reverse diagnostics are probes (crossing-slope report-only); allowed_events = ()
rules.selection: largest minimum actual downforce gain over both grids among the accepted positive steps; exact ties choose the smaller step
rules.verdicts: OPT01_V1_ACCEPT (a step selected), OPT01_V1_REJECT (no positive step both gate-eligible and accepted; integrity complete), OPT01_V1_INCOMPLETE (any integrity failure: no analysis is written); ACCEPT or REJECT closes #30 (plan E5), INCOMPLETE does not
